records.source: I can't believe they made a Prairie King movie... I hope it's good!
records.translation: Hindi ako makapaniwalang gumawa sila ng pelikula tungkol sa Hari ng Kapatagan... Sana ay maganda iyon!

records.source: Listen... it's got that old familiar music.$h
records.translation: Pakinggan mo... iyan ang pamilyar na lumang musika.$h

records.source: Well the acting was awful, but I still had a great time.$h
records.translation: Napakapangit ng pag-arte, pero nasiyahan pa rin ako.$h

records.source: I'm excited to 'explore our vibrant world'... aren't you?$h
records.translation: Sabik na akong 'galugarin ang makulay nating mundo'... ikaw rin, hindi ba?$h

records.source: I didn't know that!
records.translation: Hindi ko alam iyon!

records.source: That was really interesting. I liked the raccoons the best... they're so cute!$h
records.translation: Talagang kawili-wili iyon. Pinakanagustuhan ko ang mga rakun... napakagiliw nila!$h

records.source: I love horror movies... I hope it's scary!$h
records.translation: Gustong-gusto ko ang mga nakakatakot na pelikula... Sana ay nakakatakot ito!$h

records.source: Haha! It's not scary, but I love it.$h
records.translation: Haha! Hindi ito nakakatakot, pero gusto ko ito.$h

records.source: Abigail is giggling!
records.translation: Humahagikgik si Abigail!

records.source: That was pretty campy, but I liked it.$h
records.translation: Medyo baduy iyon, pero nagustuhan ko.$h

records.source: Hey! Thanks for inviting me, I love going to the movies.$h
records.translation: Hoy! Salamat sa pag-imbita sa akin. Gustong-gusto kong manood ng pelikula.$h

records.source: That was interesting... I wonder what I would've done in the same situation?
records.translation: Kawili-wili iyon... Ano kaya ang gagawin ko sa ganoon ding kalagayan?

records.source: From seeing the trailer, this one looks like a real snoozefest...$6
records.translation: Batay sa trailer, mukhang talagang pampatulog ito...$6

records.source: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.$6
records.translation: Gisingin mo ako kung may mangyaring kawili-wili.$6

records.source: *yawn*... that was pretty boring, wasn't it?$6
records.translation: *hikab*... nakababagot iyon, hindi ba?$6

records.source: I've always loved movies about the wild west, so I'm really excited to see this!
records.translation: Noon ko pa gustong-gusto ang mga pelikula tungkol sa Lumang Kanluran, kaya sabik na akong mapanood ito!

records.source: That was great! It really felt authentic, with the costumes and everything.
records.translation: Napakaganda niyon! Talagang tunay ang dating, mula sa mga kasuotan hanggang sa lahat ng iba pa.

records.source: This movie looks so cute, I was really hoping someone would invite me!
records.translation: Mukhang napakagiliw ng pelikulang ito. Umaasa talaga akong may mag-aanyaya sa akin!

records.source: I hope the poor little guy will be okay...$s
records.translation: Sana ay maging maayos ang kaawa-awang munting nilalang...$s

records.source: That was adorable. Thanks so much for inviting me to this!
records.translation: Napakaganda niyon. Maraming salamat sa pag-imbita sa akin!

records.source: '{0}'... I have no idea what this is about! I hope it's not violent.
records.translation: '{0}'... Wala akong kaalam-alam kung tungkol saan ito! Sana ay hindi ito marahas.

records.source: That wasn't bad! I'll have to ask Abigail about it when I'm home, I'm sure she's seen it.$h
records.translation: Hindi naman iyon masama! Itatanong ko kay Abigail pag-uwi ko. Tiyak na napanood na niya iyon.$h

records.source: I have a feeling this one's going to be a let-down... But I'm still interested to give it a try.
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay mabibigo ako rito... Pero interesado pa rin akong subukan ito.

records.source: That was silly... I bet Pierre would like it.$s
records.translation: Kalokohan iyon... Tiyak na magugustuhan iyon ni Pierre.$s

records.source: I'm nervous about this one... *gulp*
records.translation: Kinakabahan ako rito... *lunok*

records.source: I'm scared!$8
records.translation: Natatakot ako!$8

records.source: Harvey is shaking!
records.translation: Nanginginig si Harvey!

records.source: I have a fear of heights, so those soaring aerial shots really got to me... Still, I had a good time overall.$h
records.translation: Takot ako sa matataas na lugar, kaya talagang kinabahan ako sa mga kuhang tila lumilipad sa himpapawid... Gayunman, nasiyahan ako sa kabuuan.$h

records.source: I read a glowing review of this movie in the Zuzu City Times...
records.translation: Nabasa ko ang napakagandang pagsusuri sa pelikulang ito sa Zuzu City Times...

records.source: It really makes you think, doesn't it?
records.translation: Talagang mapapaisip ka rito, hindi ba?
